| # Object 0x1007 synchronous window length {#object-0x1007-synchronous-window-length-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

It contains the length of the time window for synchronous messages in us. It is 0, if not used.

 

  Index           0x1007
  --------------- ---------------------------
  Name            Synchronous Window Length
  Object          VAR
  Data Type       UNSIGNED32
  Category        Optional
  Access          RW
  PDO Mapping     No
  Value Range     UNSIGNED32
  Default Value   0x00000000
